scope: Primary sources checked in the preceding scientific review; no equivalent force/acceleration limit is inferred from an energy accuracy estimate.

sources.title: Ground state in the Faddeev-Skyrme model
sources.location: PDF page 2: energy-change stopping criteria, angle refinement and perturbation tests; pages 3–4: terraces and box/discretization checks
sources.criterion: Relative energy change about 1e-9 after an earlier 1e-7 criterion; recognition of known states is an alternative path in that paper. These do not supply a transferable normalized-force/acceleration limit.

sources.title: Knots in the Skyrme-Faddeev model
sources.criterion: Artificial kinetic-energy removal; absolute energy bias of order 1% and relative energy accuracy around 0.1% are reported accuracy estimates, not residual stopping gates.

sources.title: Cabling in the Skyrme-Faddeev model
sources.criterion: 301^3 grid at spacing 0.06, artificial energy minimization and position/twist views; no equivalent pair of normalized-force and maximum-acceleration cutoffs specified in the methods description.
